description: This file defines the 'SelectedFilterField' entity class, which models a database table for storing filter field selections used within reports in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for report linkage, filter field linkage, order, values, operator, and type, with appropriate ORM annotations.

classes.name: SelectedFilterField
classes.description: Entity class representing a filter field selected within a report, mapping to the 'ohrm_selected_filter_field' database table, with properties for report, filter field, order, values, operator, and type.

methods.name: getFilterFieldOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the filter field.

methods.name: setFilterFieldOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of the filter field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the filter field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the filter field.
